title: sheaf
description: The fixed point that settling packages: a pair {base, section} of the value-saturated predication base together with a globally agreeing section that glues the local settlements into a single whole. It is the crystal the four-regime descent deposits.

base.description: the value-saturated predication base the descent settled over

section.description: the globally agreeing assignment over the base

glues.description: the local settlements glue into a globally agreeing whole with no obstruction

cohomologyVanishes.description: the unique fixed point under confluence makes gluing succeed: H^1 = 0, no disagreement among local settlements
